rule: R36 - record the floor scope verbatim and carry the count in the Nr column. NEVER pre-multiply at measurement time.
read_from: the subtitle or scope line immediately below the drawing title

patterns.label: FL{start}-FL{end}
patterns.note: EMSQUARE's form: the floors in brackets after TYP, no FLOOR or LEVEL word. Read as undetermined before, so the 4th/5th floor plan's tags were counted once.

patterns.multiplier: count of the distinct ordinals captured
patterns.label: FL{ordinals}
patterns.note: the form the development package actually uses. Absent from the reference's example list and added from the corpus.

patterns.multiplier: count of the level numbers captured
patterns.label: FL{numbers}

patterns.resolve: derive the total floor count from the section drawing
patterns.on_no_section_drawing: HALT - record a gap and prompt. Never default to 1.
patterns.label: ALL_FLOORS
{matched text}
patterns.see_also: a level-less named area such as TYPICAL POOL falls to the default rule and carries NO_LEVEL_TOKEN

patterns.label: {floor} / {zone}
patterns.note: each zone produces its own measurement row carrying the zone qualifier

edge_cases.action: HALT and prompt; a fallback of 1 is permitted only with the fallback disclosed on the row

edge_cases.case: overlapping typical ranges - L3-L9 typical plus an L5 exception
edge_cases.action: the explicit non-typical drawing governs for its floor; the range loses that floor from its count

edge_cases.case: hyphenated or lettered floor names - FL 7A, FL 7B

edge_cases.action: multiplier is the count of named levels

audit.requires: at least five drawings listed with drawing number, title, subtitle, scale, revision, floors covered and multiplier, plus every UNRESOLVED title-block pattern

default.note: the subtitle is recorded verbatim and the row carries the flag. A level-less named area - TYPICAL POOL, PLANT ROOM - reaches the bill as one instance with the flag showing that no level token was read, never as a silent assumption.

typical_alone.when: the subtitle contains TYPICAL and no pattern above matched
typical_alone.meaning: undetermined, which is a GAP and never a silent 1
typical_alone.why: getting this wrong was measured at a 16 to 58 per cent undercount - the largest single error the pipeline can make
